Agent Name: WebSurfer
 Step Number: 18
 Reason for Mistake: Instead of clicking the correct search result link (“Athlete count for 1928 Summer Olympics - Olympedia”), the WebSurfer manually entered an incorrect URL (“https://www.olympedia.org/counts/edition”), which returned a 404. This misnavigation prevented accessing the athlete counts by country, stalling progress toward determining the country with the fewest athletes.
